text: The Project Manager will write and deliver the report summarizing all decisions made so far by four o'clock.
The group adopted four as the remote control button count.
The product will use a hand dynamo as the power source and the LCD display will be kept.
An integrated scroll-wheel push-button will be adopted as the primary control with Up, Down, and OK functions.

Budget constraints threaten the four-button design, with the price reduced by one and a half euros and some features dropped to stay within budget; dropping the LCD would destroy the concept and the integrated button is costly.
